newsitem.title: USA: AirWays sees Q3 oper loss.
newsitem.headline: AirWays sees Q3 oper loss.

text.p: AirWays Corp said on Tuesday that it expects a "sizable, but substantially reduced operating loss" in the third quarter ending December 1996.
AirWays, which reported a second quarter loss, said traffic in October should improve over September's results.
In recent months, the airline has been realigning a portion of its route system that has not met revenue and profit objectives.
The third quarter is expected to mark the final period of substantial, above-plan expenses related to enhancing the airline's operations and systems, AirWays said in a statement.
Airways said its operating results for the third quarter will also be affected by one-time costs associated with system realignments.
Last year's third quarter results were not immediately available. The company was not available for comment.

In its statement the company said increased aircraft utilization starting in February is expected to result in further improvements in the company's operating results during the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997.
